item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 09/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coastal areas of Guangdong tomorrow. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coastal areas of southern China on Tuesday. It will remain cool in the morning in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 10/01 (Monday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Sunny intervals during the day. Cool in the morning.
Temp range: 17 - 21 C
R.H. range: 70 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 11/01 (Tuesday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5.
Weather: One or two light rain patches at first. Dry with sunny periods during the day. Cool in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 16 - 20 C
R.H. range: 50 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 12/01 (Wednesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5.
Weather: Sunny intervals. Cool in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 15 - 19 C
R.H. range: 60 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 13/01 (Thursday)
Wind: East to northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine. Cool in the morning. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 16 - 21 C
R.H. range: 55 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 14/01 (Friday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Sunny intervals. Cool in the morning.
Temp range: 16 - 19 C

Date/Month: 18/01 (Tuesday)
